incident-bot: ALERT: runtime-service: elevated 5xx and timeouts observed in us-west1 across model-serving fleet. auto-page to oncall. Aggregated error rate spike to ~4.2% starting at 2026-03-15T15:12:01Z. Suspected runtime crashes/OOMs. Paging oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: I'm on it. ack. rerouting traffic to standby region now? any immediate mitigation playbook?

simran: seeing repeated segfaults in model-runner on a subset of GPUs. log snippets show repeated "double free"/"invalid pointer" after kvcache flush on long-context requests to gptx-3-quantized.

simran: tail from node gpu-prod-23:
```
[2026-03-15T15:11:58Z] model-runner[pid=4210]: ERROR: free(): invalid pointer
[2026-03-15T15:12:00Z] model-runner[pid=4210]: Fatal signal 11 (Segmentation fault)
[2026-03-15T15:12:00Z] kernel: watchdog: gpu0 reset
```

anya: customer-impact: top affected tenants: AcmeCorp (10% of their inference calls), BetaSearch (partial queries), ~12 internal prod routes degraded. Affected requests mostly long-context (>2048 tokens) chat sessions.

maria: quick mitigation suggestion: 1) toggle kvcache off (it's the likely trigger for double-free on quant kernels) 2) roll traffic to model-variant "gptx-3-quant-safe" (no kvcache / different allocator) 3) scale down batch size to 1 for all long-context routes. I'll prepare the reroute.

sre-desk: ops runbook commands below — use cautiously, we have to avoid mass restarts during peak:
```
# disable kvcache config for route set
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routes/long-context/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"kv_cache_enabled":false}
'

# promote fallback model variant
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/reroute" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","to":"gptx-3-quant-safe","weight":1.0}'

# reduce batch size
kubectl set env deploy/model-runner BATCH_SIZE=1 -n inference
```

oncall-ryan: doing the reroute now. will also increase logging and capture core dumps. telling infra to cordon gpu-prod-23.

simran: please do not restart the whole node yet — some pods are in the middle of checkpointing. better to cordon and drain after failover completes.

prod-ops-bot: statuspage: create incident ticket? severity: degraded. draft message suggested: "We're seeing elevated 5xx errors for inference requests in us-west1. We're investigating and have started mitigation."

maria: numbers update: spike started ~15:12 UTC, peak 4.2% 5xx. After initial reroute to fallback and kvcache toggle (15:18 UTC) error rate fell to ~0.8%. still elevated due to a handful of nodes; focusing on isolating bad nodes.

anya: customers notified via status page and targeted DM to AcmeCorp and BetaSearch. CS is offering retry guidance and temporary quota bump if they want to shift to other regions.

simran: root cause hypothesis: a regression in quantized attention allocator interacting with kvcache flush under long-context workloads -> leads to heap corruption and segfaults. reproducer in staging with long seq + kvcache enabled. creating a debug build with extra malloc checks.

sre-desk: next steps:
- keep fallback variant promoted until full patch and validation (TBD)
- cordon + drain suspicious nodes (gpu-prod-23, gpu-prod-19)
- capture cores and upload to S3: /tmp/cores/ to s3://redwood-cores/3175004321/
- run canary for the fixed runtime on 2 pods

oncall-ryan: cordoned gpu-prod-23. draining now. traffic shows continued improvement — current 5xx 0.35% (15:27 UTC). I'll keep watch for 30m then remove page.

simran: uploaded core dumps and heap traces to s3://redwood-cores/3175004321/. brief stack shows corrupted free in quant_attention::kv_flush.

maria: updated impact summary for postmortem: total errors ~1.1M requests in window, ~44k 5xx. Affected customers list attached to ticket. Estimated customer-facing downtime: partial degradation for 15 minutes peak; ongoing reduced errors until complete mitigation.

anya: product asks: do we need an advisory or rollback? current plan: keep fallback variant active, we don't have a safe rollback to pre-regression at scale without impacting latency/cost. engineering to push hotfix with allocator checks in next few hours.

simran: yes hotfix branch ready, running extended canary in staging. plan to ship patch + rebuild quant kernel with debug allocator, then roll 10% -> 50% -> 100% across us-west1 once green.

oncall-ryan: I'll keep monitoring. setting status: monitoring. will escalate if >0.5% errors again. thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status changed: active -> mitigated (monitoring). Mitigation timestamp: 2026-03-15T15:27:18Z. Keep thread for postmortem notes and followups.
